ablation.notes: Phase 4H.2e: Asymmetric HF weights (w_lh=1.5, w_hl=0.5). LH=horizontal edges (low-pass rows, high-pass cols), HL=vertical edges. Hypothesis: horizontal strokes dominate art styles (brushwork direction), so emphasizing LH may improve clip. Tests directional style transfer. Current 0.3:1.0:1.0 → 0.3:1.5:0.5.
